name: leadflow-crm-monorepo
description: LeadFlow CRM - Agency Lead and Follow-up Management System

scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.bundle:backend: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('frontend/dist', 'backend/public', { recursive: true, force: true }); console.log('Copied dist to backend/public');"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install

author: SDE Intern
